subtitle: A framework to support the evaluation of computational solutions
description_1: Properly evaluating a product is crucial to ensuring that it meets requirements and expectations. In software development, effective evaluation allows you to identify issues that may have gone unnoticed in earlier stages of the process.
description_2: EmoFrame is a digital environment that offers support in the evaluation stage, helping to highlight potential flaws. Our solution is designed to consider several factors, such as the user profile and the environment where the evaluation will be carried out, offering a careful selection of the most appropriate evaluation methods.
description_3: Choosing the right method can be challenging, especially in the Human-Computer Interaction field, due to its interdisciplinary nature. EmoFrame combines tools from different domains to support specialists in computer science and other fields in the systematic application of these tools, aiming to provide accurate and reliable results.
reasoningItemDescription_1: Takes into account everything from the user profile to the evaluation environment, ensuring that the chosen method is the most appropriate.
reasoningItemDescription_2: Combines instruments from different domains for systematic and effective application
reasoningItemDescription_3: Ideal for computer specialists and related areas looking for an integrated and practical solution
reasoningItemDescription_4: Designed for the interdisciplinary field of HCI, but also applicable to other areas
knowMoreDescription: Find out how EmoFrame can optimise your software evaluation process and improve the quality of your product.
